clog.text: The council meets, but no one has spoken for anything yet.
Mex-76 spoke of a dome at the meeting in the habitat: a roof of sky, and streets without suits.
The council is divided over the dome. Rask-62 speaks for building it, for the children to come; Ixle-2 says not yet, steady as ever.
The talk of a dome has gone round and round. The council lets it rest for now.
Radra-40 raised the dome again at the meeting in the habitat.
